From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 08:00:00 -0800
Subject: Intro call: 20-min phone — matching PST & CET windows

Hi Viktor —

Thanks again for applying and for the resume you shared (attached). I’d love to do a short 20-minute intro to learn a bit about your background and share a quick overview of the role. I know timezones can be annoying — below are three windows in Pacific Time with the CET conversions so it’s easier to scan: 

• Tue Feb 2 — 4:30pm PT / Wed Feb 3 00:30am CET (late evening for you)
• Wed Feb 3 — 8:00am PT / Wed Feb 3 16:00 CET (afternoon CET)
• Wed Feb 3 — 11:30am PT / Wed Feb 3 19:30 CET (evening CET)

If any of those work, reply with the slot you prefer and I’ll send a calendar invite (or you can grab a slot on my Calendly link: https://calendly.com/irene-choi/20min-intro). If none of those fit, please propose 2–3 windows in CET and I’ll convert.

A couple quick items for context:
- This is a preliminary phone screen (20 minutes) with me.
- We’ll cover your experience, motivation, and a few technical/role fit questions.
- If it looks like a fit we’ll loop in Marcus (Hiring Manager) for an interview loop.

Attached: Viktor_Orlov_Resume.pdf (from your application)

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Recruiter, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193

One note — the 00:30 CET slot is a bit late that day, and the 19:30 option slightly conflicts with another call. So I’ll take the 16:00 CET slot. Please send the invite.

My phone for the call: +420 777 123 456 (mobile). If you prefer Zoom, that’s fine too. Attached is my resume again in case you need the copy.

Best,
Viktor Orlov
viktor.orlov@gmail.com
